release_notes: iPos Sync Agent v0.6.3 sources each Meta Catalog product description live from WooCommerce: it uses the product's short_description (HTML stripped to plain text, truncated to 9999 chars) and falls back to the long description when short_description is empty, sending an empty description only when both are blank - no extra API calls and no changes to what is written back to WooCommerce. The Meta live-sync completion popup no longer shows the 'Diblokir permanen' (permanently blocked) line; the underlying blocklist mechanism is unchanged, just not displayed. The Logs tab now keeps only the last 5 sync runs (old runs are pruned at the start of each sync, never touching the run in progress) and adds a manual 'Bersihkan Log' (Clear Logs) button that wipes all logs from a background thread after confirmation. No changes to WooCommerce sync logic or pricing.
